verdict.rationale: Drata documents OAuth setup for its API (drata-docs-6), says AI agents can interact with Drata (drata-docs-2), and has an official MCP server (drata-probe-4), so issuing API credentials an agent could use is plausibly supported. Nothing in the evidence shows those credentials can be scoped or restricted to least privilege. The drata-agent 'READ ONLY' notes refer to the device agent's access to system preferences, not API credentials, so they do not count here. missing for 10: documented per-credential scopes/permission granularity, read-only or resource-limited API keys, agent-specific credential issuance guidance, independent corroboration.
